title: macOS desktop client: native kith app for macOS
description:
A native desktop client for kith on macOS.

Scope:
- Connect to user's kithd over tailnet (tailscaled already running on macOS)
- Contact list, chat list, message thread (1:1 and group)
- Send/receive messages; read receipts; attachment upload/download
- macOS UserNotifications framework for notifications
- Menu bar icon with unread count
- EventSource for live push
- Finder integration / QuickLook for attachments
- Target: SwiftUI + AppKit where needed (macOS 13+ Ventura minimum) OR Tauri for code sharing with Linux/Windows desktop; decide in research phase
- Notarization required for distribution outside App Store
- Distribution: .dmg direct download; Mac App Store submission optional
